_comment: Hearthbound: companions-fabric-1.20.1-1.3.2.jar hardcodes this structure's biomes as an INLINE list, so no datapack tag merge can reach it — it generated ONLY in minecraft:dark_forest, in RU territory as much as in BWG's. Full-file override, identical to stock except the biomes list. a dark_forest tower guarded by witches and evokers — extended to RU and BWG dark forests. Re-derive from the jar with .claude/tools/gen-inline-structure-overrides.js if the mod updates.
